messages:
deploy-bot: heads-up: starting v2 rollout in 30m (canary=5% us-east, rollout-id=roll-2026-03-20-01). @emma @raj please ack and /eyes. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2/2026-03-20

emma: ack, I'll be on watch. linking release notes to the client migration doc.

raj: quick reminder — v2 enforces canonical header X-Redwood-Version:2 for some internal routing. we added a fallthrough, but 3rd-party integrations might strip unknown headers. keep an eye on partner proxies.

sam: noted. do we have a soft-fallback toggle if partner headers are stripped?

emma: yes — default behavior is fallback-to-v1 for requests missing the header, but the gateway will log and increment partner-mismatch metric. noise threshold set to 1% for canary.

deploy-bot: deploy started -> stage=canary, targets=5% us-east, tag=roll-2026-03-20-01

ops-oncall: seeing a small uptick in 502s to third-party auth service at ~+0.8% (baseline 0.05%). correlating with canary CIDR ranges. pinging infra.

lina: the partner-team just pinged — their older SDK strips unknown headers by default. they're at 1.2% of traffic and haven't rolled their fix.

emma: can we pin those tenant IDs to v1 temporarily? I think we should hold on full rollout until partner rolls SDK patch.

raj: agreed. propose: 1) pause global rollout, 2) apply tenant-level pin for partner-tenant-42 and partner-tenant-77, 3) enable deploybot immediate rollback criteria if partner error rate >2% for 5m.

sam: +1. operational playbook: if we see >1.5% auth errors across canary for 10m, manual rollback to previous config. who will run the pin? @emma?

emma: I'll do the pin now. command: ```/deploypin set tenant=partner-tenant-42 v=1 comment=\"protect until partner SDK patched\"```

deploy-bot: pin command accepted. tenant=partner-tenant-42 pinned to v1 by emma.

emma: pin partner-tenant-77 now.

deploy-bot: pin command accepted. tenant=partner-tenant-77 pinned to v1 by emma.

ops-oncall: after pins, 502s dropped back to baseline within 2m. partner error metric now 0.09%. good rollback safety net.

mobile-team: heads-up — some mobile SDK users still on v1 signal. do we need to call out release notes and pin lists publicly?

emma: yes, updating release notes with pinned-tenant table and callout: \"If you see traffic routed to v1 despite v2 rollout, check tenant pin list.\" Link: https://internal.redwood/release/v2/notes#tenant-pins

raj: also toggle a header-normalize shim in gateway for a limited time. it will canonicalize header names (case-insensitive) and forward if present under alt names. Not long-term, but reduces partner friction.

sam: is that an ops-safe toggle? any perf regressions?

lina: tested in staging, negligible latency impact (~0.3ms p95). I'll enable for canary only.

deploy-bot: gateway-toggle applied: header-normalize=true for canary group.

emma: with pins + header shim, I recommend resuming the rollout to 10% but exclude pinned tenants. propose resume in 15m with tight telemetry: auth-errors, 5xx, partner-mismatch logs, and per-tenant traffic.

raj: set alert thresholds: auth-errors >0.5% sustained over 5m -> auto-pause; partner-mismatch logs >2% -> page oncall.

ops-oncall: will watch. also adding a trace sampling increase for canary to 50% to get detailed headers on failing requests.

mobile-team: pinging key customers about pins and expected behavior. we'll include remediation steps: upgrade SDK to 2.1.3 or set allowUnknownHeaders=true.

deploy-bot: rollout resumed -> stage=canary, targets=10% us-east, excluded_tenants=[partner-tenant-42,partner-tenant-77], tag=roll-2026-03-20-01

ops-oncall: 3m in — auth-errors 0.12%, partner-mismatch 0.4%, overall 5xx flat. no pages yet.

lina: header-normalize is holding; partner telemetry shows alt-header present in 82% of their failing requests — shim helps.

emma: good. action items: 1) ops keep watch for 30m, 2) product to follow up with partner for urgent SDK rollout (raj), 3) release notes updated with pin list and rollback criteria (emma).

raj: I'll reach out to partner PM and offer temporary proxy rule they can drop-in if they can't ship SDK in next 48h.

mobile-team: we'll coordinate a small mobile patch and announce to customers.

deploy-bot: canary completed 30m with no alert triggers. next step: slow roll to 30% over 2h with same exclusions. schedule: start in 10m.

emma: leaving this thread open for operator updates. thanks all. :thumbsup:
